Senses.Explanation: A stringless lute is a lute denied the strings by which an ordinary lute produces notes. Chan questions still ask the named respondent or an unnamed interlocutor to play it; verses speak of a tune on it and of hearing it, and Baichi speaks of playing it with a tune that has no fixed melody. The missing mechanism and retained performance form the recurring contrast.
